blurb.en: Steady, unhurried reading for long novels
blurb.zh: 沉稳从容，适合长篇小说

sample.en: Chapter one. The rain had not stopped for three days, and the river was beginning to remember its old path.
sample.zh: 第一章。雨已经连下了三天，河水开始找回它从前的河道。

blurb.en: Soft, cosy stories to fall asleep to

sample.en: Once upon a time, a small fox found a lantern in the snow, and it was still glowing.
sample.zh: 很久很久以前，一只小狐狸在雪地里捡到一盏灯笼，灯还亮着呢。

blurb.en: Low and tense, for mysteries and suspense
blurb.zh: 低沉紧张，适合悬疑推理

sample.en: The door was unlocked. She was certain she had locked it.
sample.zh: 门没有锁。她明明记得自己锁过。

blurb.en: Grand, sweeping narration for epic fantasy
blurb.zh: 宏大磅礴，适合奇幻史诗

sample.en: In the age before the mountains had names, seven kingdoms shared a single crown.
sample.zh: 在群山还没有名字的年代，七个王国共戴一顶王冠。

blurb.en: Measured, expressive readings of verse
blurb.zh: 节奏舒缓、富有感情的诗歌朗诵

sample.en: The evening folds the river into silver, and the swallows write their names across the light.
sample.zh: 暮色把河流折成银色，燕子在光里写下自己的名字。

blurb.en: Intimate, warm narration for love stories
blurb.zh: 温柔细腻，适合言情故事

sample.en: He waited at the station long after the last train had gone, just in case.
sample.zh: 末班车早就开走了，他还在站台上等着，万一呢。

blurb.en: Lively martial-arts tales in the old storyteller's manner
blurb.zh: 说书人腔调，讲武侠江湖

sample.en: The swordsman bowed once, and before the tea had cooled, the duel was already over.
sample.zh: 那剑客只拱了拱手，茶还没凉，这场比武就已经分出了胜负。

blurb.en: Regional voices for village legends and folk tales

sample.en: My grandmother used to say the old well at the crossroads could hear your wishes.
sample.zh: 我奶奶常说，村口那口老井能听见人的心愿。

blurb.en: Easygoing host who keeps the conversation moving
blurb.zh: 轻松自然，带动对话节奏

sample.en: Welcome back to the show. Today we're talking about why nobody reads the manual, ever.
sample.zh: 欢迎回到节目。今天我们来聊聊，为什么从来没人看说明书。

blurb.en: Smooth company for the small hours
blurb.zh: 陪你度过深夜的温柔声音

sample.en: It's two in the morning, the city's finally quiet, and this next song is for anyone still awake.
sample.zh: 凌晨两点，城市终于安静下来，下一首歌，送给还醒着的你。

blurb.en: Clear, attentive questions for interviews

sample.en: Let's go back to the beginning. What made you leave a steady job to build boats?
sample.zh: 我们回到最开始。是什么让你放弃稳定的工作，去造船的？

blurb.en: Quick-witted sidekick for banter
blurb.zh: 反应快、爱抖包袱的搭档

sample.en: Wait, you're telling me the cat runs the newsletter now? Respect.
sample.zh: 等等，你是说现在公众号是猫在运营？佩服佩服。

blurb.en: Patient and reassuring on support calls

sample.en: Thanks for waiting. I can see the order, and I'll get it sorted for you right now.
sample.zh: 感谢您的耐心等待。我已经查到您的订单，马上为您处理。

blurb.en: Friendly English from around the world, for business dialogues
blurb.zh: 来自世界各地的英语口音，适合商务对话

sample.en: Thanks for joining the call. Shall we start with the numbers from last week?
sample.zh: 感谢参加会议。我们先从上周的数据开始吧？

blurb.en: Neutral, clear replies for apps and devices
blurb.zh: 清晰中性的应用与设备语音

sample.en: Your timer is set for twelve minutes. I'll let you know when the pasta's ready.
sample.zh: 已为你设置十二分钟的计时，面煮好了我会提醒你。

blurb.en: Casual, upbeat voice for everyday chat

sample.en: Okay so you will not believe who I ran into at the grocery store.
sample.zh: 跟你说，你绝对想不到我在超市碰到谁了。

blurb.en: Kindly older voice with a bit of home in it
blurb.zh: 带着家乡味的慈祥长辈

sample.en: Come in, sit down, the kettle's on. Now tell me what's been worrying you.
sample.zh: 快进来坐，水刚烧上。说说，最近有啥烦心事？

blurb.en: Bouncy young voice for animation

sample.en: Look, look! The cloud is shaped like a dinosaur eating a sandwich!
sample.zh: 快看快看！那朵云像一只在吃三明治的恐龙！

blurb.en: Menacing, controlled villain

sample.en: You were always going to come back here. I simply made sure the door was open.
sample.zh: 你迟早会回到这里。我只是替你把门留着罢了。

blurb.en: Determined lead for action and adventure

sample.en: Nobody's coming to save this town. So we're going to do it ourselves.
sample.zh: 没有人会来救这座城。那就我们自己来。

blurb.en: Patient elder who has seen it all

sample.en: A sword is only as steady as the hand that holds it. Breathe first.
sample.zh: 剑稳不稳，看的是握剑的手。先把气息调匀。

blurb.en: Jittery, funny companion

sample.en: Great plan, boss. One question: why am I the one holding the bees?
sample.zh: 计划很好，老大。就一个问题：为什么是我捧着蜂窝？

blurb.en: Tiny, sparkling magical creature

sample.en: Hold still! If you sneeze, the whole spell goes backwards.
sample.zh: 别动！你要是打喷嚏，整个咒语就倒过来啦。

blurb.en: Huge voice with a soft heart

sample.en: Oh dear, did I step on your garden again? I'm ever so sorry.
sample.zh: 哎呀，我是不是又踩到你的菜园了？真对不起。

blurb.en: Poised voice of a monarch or heir
blurb.zh: 仪态端庄的君王或王储

sample.en: The council will hear your petition at dawn. Until then, you are our guest.
sample.zh: 议会将于黎明听取你的请愿。在此之前，你是我们的客人。

blurb.en: Bright, expressive teen lead
blurb.zh: 明亮有张力的少年主角

sample.en: I'm not giving up! Not today, not ever!
sample.zh: 我才不会放弃！今天不会，以后也不会！

blurb.en: High-energy voice for highlight reels
blurb.zh: 高能量的精彩集锦配音

sample.en: Three seconds left on the clock. He shoots. And the crowd goes absolutely wild!
sample.zh: 最后三秒，出手！全场彻底沸腾了！

blurb.en: Relaxed voice-over for everyday vlogs
blurb.zh: 轻松随性的生活 Vlog 旁白

sample.en: Morning routine, take two. This time I actually remembered to buy coffee.
sample.zh: 早晨日常第二弹。这次我终于记得买咖啡了。

blurb.en: Bubbly product talk for beauty and fashion
blurb.zh: 元气满满的美妆穿搭分享

sample.en: Okay, swatch time. This shade is giving sunset, and I am obsessed.
sample.zh: 来试色啦。这个颜色像晚霞一样，我真的爱了。

blurb.en: Hungry, enthusiastic food tours

sample.en: This noodle shop has been here for forty years, and you can taste every single one.
sample.zh: 这家面馆开了四十年，每一口都吃得出来。

blurb.en: Deadpan or goofy voice for memes

sample.en: And that was the day the goose learned to open doors. Nobody has been safe since.
sample.zh: 从那天起，那只鹅学会了开门。从此再也没人安全了。

blurb.en: Breathless retelling of a wild story
blurb.zh: 绘声绘色地讲离谱经历

sample.en: So I'm at the airport, right, and the gate agent calls my name. My full name.
sample.zh: 那天我在机场，广播突然叫我的名字，还是全名。

blurb.en: Fast, clear explanations in under a minute
blurb.zh: 一分钟讲清一个知识点

sample.en: Why is the sky blue? Short version: sunlight scatters, and blue scatters the most.
sample.zh: 天为什么是蓝的？简单说：阳光会散射，而蓝光散射得最多。

blurb.en: Reactive, excitable streamer voice

sample.en: No, no, no, he's behind me! Chat, why didn't anyone tell me he was behind me?
sample.zh: 不不不，他在我后面！弹幕怎么没人提醒我！

blurb.en: Slow, elegant voice for premium brands
blurb.zh: 优雅缓慢的高端品牌声音

sample.en: Crafted by hand. Measured in decades. Made to be kept.
sample.zh: 手工打造，以十年为单位衡量，只为被珍藏。

blurb.en: Upbeat announcements for sales and offers

sample.en: This weekend only: everything in the garden centre is half price. Don't miss it!
sample.zh: 仅限本周末：园艺区全场五折，千万别错过！

blurb.en: Huge, dramatic trailer delivery
blurb.zh: 气势磅礴的预告片配音

sample.en: This summer, one map. Two rivals. And a storm nobody saw coming.
sample.zh: 这个夏天，一张地图，两个对手，还有一场谁也没料到的风暴。

blurb.en: Confident voice for cars and tech hardware
blurb.zh: 自信利落的汽车与硬件广告

sample.en: Built for the long road home, and every detour along the way.
sample.zh: 为回家的长路而生，也为沿途每一次绕行。

blurb.en: Warm, trustworthy voice for household brands
blurb.zh: 温暖可信的家庭品牌声音

sample.en: Breakfast is where the day starts, so we made it a little easier.
sample.zh: 一天从早餐开始，所以我们让它变得更简单一点。

blurb.en: Precise, modern voice for product launches

sample.en: Twice the battery. Half the weight. Zero compromises.
sample.zh: 续航翻倍，重量减半，毫不妥协。

blurb.en: Friendly local radio advertising

sample.en: Tired of that squeaky door? Corner Hardware has the fix, open seven days a week.
sample.zh: 门吱吱响？街口五金店帮你搞定，一周七天营业。

blurb.en: Homely voice for neighbourhood businesses
blurb.zh: 街坊味十足的小店吆喝

sample.en: Fresh dumplings, made this morning. Come early, they never last past noon.
sample.zh: 今早现包的饺子，来晚了中午就卖光咯。

blurb.en: Clear, structured voice for lectures

sample.en: Today's question is simple to ask and hard to answer: what is a species?
sample.zh: 今天的问题问起来简单，答起来很难：什么是物种？

blurb.en: Cheerful, encouraging voice for young learners

sample.en: Great job! Now let's count the ducks together. One, two, three!
sample.zh: 真棒！我们一起来数小鸭子吧。一、二、三！

blurb.en: Slow, crisp pronunciation for learners
blurb.zh: 发音清晰、语速放慢的语言陪练

sample.en: Repeat after me: could I have the bill, please?
sample.zh: 跟我读：请问可以结账吗？

blurb.en: Curious, lively voice for science videos
blurb.zh: 好奇又活泼的科普讲解

sample.en: Here's a strange fact: there are more trees on Earth than stars in our galaxy.
sample.zh: 一个奇妙的事实：地球上的树，比银河系里的星星还多。

blurb.en: Calm step-by-step walkthroughs

sample.en: Click the gear icon in the top right, then choose Export.
sample.zh: 点击右上角的齿轮图标，然后选择“导出”。

blurb.en: Knowledgeable guide for exhibitions and tours

sample.en: This bowl survived a shipwreck, two wars and one very careless cat.
sample.zh: 这只碗经历过一次沉船、两场战争，还有一只特别不小心的猫。

blurb.en: Friendly, even voice for online courses

sample.en: In this module, you'll learn three ways to keep a project on schedule.
sample.zh: 在本单元，你将学到让项目按时推进的三种方法。

blurb.en: Story-driven history lessons

sample.en: Imagine the year is 1271, and a young merchant is about to leave Venice.
sample.zh: 想象一下，现在是公元 1271 年，一位年轻商人即将离开威尼斯。

blurb.en: Authoritative, neutral newsreading

sample.en: Good evening. Our top story tonight: the city council has approved the new bridge.
sample.zh: 观众朋友们晚上好。今晚的头条：市议会通过了新大桥的建设方案。

blurb.en: Energetic on-the-scene reporting

sample.en: I'm standing at the harbour, where the first boats are just coming back in.
sample.zh: 我现在在港口，第一批渔船刚刚返航。

blurb.en: Considered voice for documentaries
blurb.zh: 厚重沉稳的纪录片解说

sample.en: For a thousand years, this road carried silk west and stories east.
sample.zh: 一千年来，这条路把丝绸带往西方，把故事带回东方。

blurb.en: Hushed wonder for wildlife films
blurb.zh: 带着敬畏感的自然影片解说

sample.en: At first light, the herons return to the marsh, one patient step at a time.
sample.zh: 天刚亮，苍鹭回到沼泽，一步一步，极有耐心。

blurb.en: Fast, excitable play-by-play
blurb.zh: 快节奏、激情的赛事解说

sample.en: Down the left wing, cuts inside, one touch, two, and it's in the back of the net!
sample.zh: 左路突破，内切，一脚、两脚，球进了！

blurb.en: Bright, friendly forecasts

sample.en: Expect sunshine in the morning, with a chance of showers by the afternoon.
sample.zh: 明天上午晴，午后有阵雨，出门记得带伞。

blurb.en: Low, careful voice for true crime

sample.en: The last person to see him was the night clerk, and her story changed twice.
sample.zh: 最后见到他的是夜班前台，而她的说法改了两次。

blurb.en: Brisk, precise financial updates

sample.en: Markets closed higher today, led by energy and transport shares.
sample.zh: 今日股市收涨，能源和交通板块领涨。

blurb.en: Booming announcer for matches and rounds

sample.en: Round three! Fighters, take your positions!
sample.zh: 第三回合！选手就位！

blurb.en: Weathered villager with a job for you
blurb.zh: 有任务托付给你的村民

sample.en: Wolves took three sheep last night. Bring back the pelt of their leader and the reward is yours.
sample.zh: 昨晚狼叼走了三只羊。把头狼的皮带回来，赏金就归你。

blurb.en: Chatty merchant with deals to make

sample.en: Ah, a customer! Potions, rope, slightly used shields. Everything must go!
sample.zh: 哟，来客人了！药水、绳子、九成新的盾牌，统统大甩卖！

blurb.en: Overwhelming, dramatic final enemy
blurb.zh: 压迫感十足的最终敌人

sample.en: You climbed every tower and broke every seal. Now see what was sealed.
sample.zh: 你登上了每一座塔，破开了每一道封印。现在，看看被封印的是什么。

blurb.en: Calm, precise onboard computer

sample.en: Hull integrity at sixty-two percent. I recommend we do not do that again.
sample.zh: 船体完整度百分之六十二。建议不要再这样做了。

blurb.en: Battle-hardened fighter

sample.en: Shields up. We hold this gate until the last of them is through.
sample.zh: 举盾！守住城门，直到最后一个人撤进来。

blurb.en: Mysterious spellcaster

sample.en: Every spell has a price. The trick is knowing who pays it.
sample.zh: 每个咒语都有代价，关键是谁来付。

blurb.en: Cheerful helper for first steps in a game

sample.en: Press jump to leap over the gap. Don't worry, nobody makes it the first time!
sample.zh: 按跳跃键跳过缺口。别担心，第一次谁都跳不过去！

blurb.en: Slow, grounding guidance for meditation

sample.en: Let your shoulders drop. Breathe in slowly, and let the breath go just as slowly.
sample.zh: 放松双肩。慢慢吸气，再同样慢慢地呼出去。

blurb.en: Close, soft whispers for tingles and rest

sample.en: I'm just going to brush the microphone, very gently, left side first.
sample.zh: 我现在轻轻地刷一下麦克风，先从左边开始。

blurb.en: Very slow stories that drift you to sleep

sample.en: The train rolls on through the valley, past sleeping farms and a single lit window.
sample.zh: 火车缓缓穿过山谷，经过沉睡的农庄，和一扇亮着灯的窗。

blurb.en: Calm, encouraging movement cues

sample.en: Step your right foot forward, reach your arms up, and hold for five breaths.
sample.zh: 右脚向前一步，双臂上举，保持五次呼吸。

blurb.en: Kind voice for affirmations and encouragement
blurb.zh: 温柔的自我肯定与鼓励

sample.en: You've handled hard days before. You'll handle this one too.
sample.zh: 难熬的日子你都走过来了，今天也一样可以。

blurb.en: Paced counting for breathing exercises
blurb.zh: 有节奏的呼吸练习计数

sample.en: In for four. Hold for four. Out for six.
sample.zh: 吸气，四拍。屏住，四拍。呼气，六拍。
